items.text: • New Mechanic "Mountable Robots"
When Static stasis is active, a prompt will alert you that the nearest Robot is now Mountable.
Press Dodge when near the Robot to mount it, and take it for a ride.
Steer the Robot using left and right, and press fire to make it attack other Robots.
While attacking or getting hit, the mount will consume energy.
When all of its energy is depleted it will be destroyed, and you will automatically be dismounted.
While mounted drones will lose sight. and stop following. they will retarget you when dismounted.
Once mounted you can dismount and mount the bot again as many times you like until it is destroyed,
but be careful, other bots will destroy your mount. even when you are not on it.
When mounted the UI will change to mirror the new mount controls.
You can also Make the Robot Self-Destruct bij holding ChargeBlast to create even more Chaos.
• Added the possibility to browse the tutorial using shoulder buttons.
• Added Sound when selecting achievements. (different sound for when locked/unlocked).
"Hold Tight" : Mount your first Robot
"Defector". : Destroy 20 bots using a single mount
"Exterminate" : Destroy 500 bots while mounted
"Sorry Buddy" : Use a Shield when mounted
"Calamity" : Destroy at least 5 bots using a single self-destruct
"One way ticket" : Make 10 or more robots self-destruct
